title: Nexus RecordCharacterTomRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/characters/{character_id}/tom. Closed DTO: the server admits viewer, carrier owner, selected binding, and L2 subject from stored rows before any mutation; payload claims never establish scope. holder is the epistemic subject (modules.belief[*].holder), never the MindState carrier FK. Paper aliases (actor, knowledge_access, mental_source) are not fields.

world_id.description: Selected owned active World. The viewer's binding and any L2 subject binding must be active in this World.

binding_id.description: The viewer Character's selected active binding in world_id.

carrier_entry_id.description: Carrier KnowledgeEntry id. Must be non-deleted and canonically owned by the viewer Character or by the selected binding.

expected_revision.description: OCC precondition: the carrier revision observed on read (NULL normalizes to 0).

holder.description: Epistemic subject. L1 (order 1): must equal the viewer Character id. L2 (order 2): a different Character with its own active binding to world_id.

order.description: Recursive belief depth on the Character API: 1 = L1 self-belief, 2 = L2 model of another Character. 0 and >2 reject.

access.description: Knowledge Access (handbook closed labels). Exact field name is access, not knowledge_access.

content_type.description: Content Type (handbook closed labels; slash-containing labels are literal).

source.description: Mental Source (handbook closed labels). Exact field name is source, not mental_source.

occurred_at.description: Optional when-axis: occurrence time copied onto the derivative MindState row.

sort_key.description: Optional when-axis: caller ordering key copied onto the derivative MindState row.

event_id.description: Optional when-axis: grounding TimelineEvent id recorded as the derivative MindState source_anchor. Never an inference trigger.
